question:
What will come in place of question mark (?) in the given series?

16 40 64 88 112 ?
solution:
Logic followed here is: (Previous term) + 24 = Next term.

**The sequence is as follows:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8376ebf5448fd11b91bc83a33674d9952ae04af65a28137d0c0f86c33feaa553.png]
